We're kicking off the pilot for HealthSys in the EU and our security/compliance team needs a short evidence pack to close internal review. Can you confirm the following for the pilot environment bound to our account HS-4521?

- Attestation that compute and persistent customer data for HS-4521 will be hosted only in EU zones (no crossing to non-EU regions), and list the specific region(s) (cloud provider names/regions).

- SIG/CAIQ or SOC2 pointers we can add to our questionnaire.

We need this in the next 7 business days if possible. If you have a short one-page attestation we can attach to our packet that would be ideal.

Jonas / team — attaching the artifacts per the plan. High-level notes included inline.

Attachments (attached to this internal message):
- operator_access_matrix.csv — columns: operator_email, role, access_scope (control-plane, keystore, network), 2FA_enforced, last_audit_date. This includes our on-call operators and the set of engineers with privileged keystore access; roles are job-title-level (no passwords or credentials).
- keystore_audit_log_excerpt.txt — redacted excerpt showing last rotation (2026-06-03T02:10:00Z) for the eu-west-1 key partition and the HSM vendor partition id. No key material included.
- sig_caiq_appendix.pdf — curated CAIQ pages that are relevant to residency and key management; this is our standard customer-facing appendix for SIG/CAIQ responses.

Brief answers to HealthSys bullets: 
- Residency: Pilot workload for HS-4521 is pinned to eu-west-1 (provider: AWS eu-west-1). No cross-region compute or primary storage; backups are configured to replicate within eu-west-1 snapshots only.
- VPC: Traffic for HS-4521 uses Privatelink endpoints and VPC peering under the customer's VPC model (no public tenant egress). Outbound system telemetry uses region-local endpoints and is classified as non-customer payload.
- Operator sessions: Privileged access is gated by SSO + time-limited elevation (1 hour), sessions are recorded for keystore and control-plane actions and retained per our retention policy (90 days).

I've attached the files to this internal note; Marissa / Priyom, please verify the operator matrix rows and the redaction level on the keystore excerpt is acceptable for external sharing.

Rebecca / Liam — thanks for the ask and for flagging the timeline. Please find our attestation and supporting artifacts attached. Summary below; attachments are operator_access_matrix.csv, keystore_audit_log_excerpt.txt (redacted), and sig_caiq_appendix.pdf.

Short attestation (for inclusion in HealthSys packet):
Redwood Inference attests that for pilot account HS-4521: 
- Primary compute and persistent customer data will be hosted only in AWS eu-west-1 for the pilot period. No customer data or compute will traverse or be replicated to non-EU regions.
- Customer tenant traffic is served via private endpoints (VPC endpoints/Privatelink). There is no public-Internet egress path for tenant data; outbound system telemetry is region-local and does not carry customer payloads.
- Backups and snapshots for HS-4521 are retained and replicated only within eu-west-1; there are no cross-region backups that touch non-EU zones for this pilot.
- Operator access: attached operator_access_matrix.csv lists individuals and role-level access to the control plane and keystore. Privileged access requires SSO with MFA and time-limited elevation; sessions for keystore and control-plane actions are recorded and retained for 90 days.
- Keystore: attached excerpt shows last managed rotation timestamps and HSM partitioning for EU keys. Keys for HS-4521 are stored/managed within the eu-west-1 KMS/HSM boundary. No raw key material is included in the excerpt.

We have also attached a CAIQ/SIG appendix (sig_caiq_appendix.pdf) with the relevant answers for HealthSys's questionnaire. If you need a signed/printed attestation letter on Redwood letterhead for procurement/legal, we can produce one — allow 2 business days for that variant.

Next steps: if this satisfies your compliance intake we can mark the attestation delivered; otherwise please indicate any gaps and we'll follow up. Happy to schedule a 30‑minute call to walk the HealthSys Security team through the artifacts — propose Wed 2026-07-28 11:00 CEST if useful.
